contracts/meta-ag/interfaces/IDataFeedAd.content:
// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IDataFeedAdapter
 * @notice Standardized interface for pluggable price feed adapters consumed by OracleHub
 * @dev Any protocol (PriceOracle, Sidiora pools, Chainlink, etc.) implements this to plug into OracleHub
 *
 * Confidence model:
 *   0       = no data / adapter offline
 *   1–3333  = low confidence (single source, wide spread, or stale-ish)
 *   3334–6666 = medium confidence
 *   6667–10000 = high confidence (multiple relayers, fresh, within deviation)
 *
 * Invariants (spec §6.2):
 *   I7. Never reverts on stale/missing — return confidence=0 or price=0.
 *   I8. Confidence monotonic (higher = more trustworthy). Exact banding per
 *       adapter; MUST follow the 0/low/medium/high model
 *       (0 / 1–3333 / 3334–6666 / 6667–10000).
 *   I9. timestamp is source's last update time, NOT block.timestamp.
 *       Exception: SidioraFeedAdapter uses block.timestamp because Sidiora
 *       pool prices update implicitly on every trade.
 */
interface IDataFeedAdapter {

    struct FeedPrice {
        uint256 price;
        uint256 timestamp;
        uint256 confidence;
        bytes32 sourceId;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Get the latest price for a token from this adapter
     * @dev MUST NOT revert on stale data — return confidence=0 instead
     * @param token The token address to price
     * @return feed The full FeedPrice struct; price=0 if unsupported
     */
    function getFeedPrice(address token) external view returns (FeedPrice memory feed);

    /**
     * @notice Check whether this adapter supports a given token
     * @param token The token address to check
     * @return supported True if this adapter can price the token
     */
    function supportsToken(address token) external view returns (bool supported);

    /**
     * @notice Get prices for multiple tokens in one call
     * @param tokens Array of token addresses
     * @return feeds Array of FeedPrice structs (parallel to tokens array)
     */
    function getFeedPrices(address[] calldata tokens) external view returns (FeedPrice[] memory feeds);

    /**
     * @notice Unique identifier for this adapter source (e.g., keccak256("PriceOracle.v1"))
     * @return id The bytes32 identifier
     */
    function sourceId() external view returns (bytes32 id);

    /**
     * @notice Human-readable name for this adapter
     * @return name The adapter name string
     */
    function adapterName() external pure returns (string memory name);

    /**
     * @notice Maximum age in seconds before this adapter's prices are considered stale
     * @return staleness Staleness threshold in seconds
     */
    function maxStaleness() external view returns (uint256 staleness);

    /**
     * @notice Get all tokens this adapter currently supports
     * @return tokens Array of supported token addresses
     */
    function getSupportedTokens() external view returns (address[] memory tokens);

    event AdapterRegistered(bytes32 indexed sourceId, address indexed adapter);
    event AdapterPriceServed(
        bytes32 indexed sourceId,
        address indexed token,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 confidence
    );
}

/**
 * @title IERC20Minimal
 * @notice Zero-dep minimal ERC20 surface used by the Sidiora Meta-AG stack.
 * @dev Introduced in Phase 3 (Task 3.1) as the first internal consumer of ERC20
 *      view/transfer semantics beyond oracle reads. Later phases (engine,
 *      adapters, router) reuse this interface verbatim to keep the meta-ag
 *      layer free of external dependencies.
 *
 *      This file is scoped to `contracts/meta-ag/` and does not expand the
 *      Phase 1 frozen public surface — it is an internal utility interface.
 */
interface IERC20Minimal {
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);

    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);

    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IMetaAGQuoter
 * @notice Read-only vault-side quote layer for frontends. Spec §7.11.
 * @dev UUPS-upgradeable, Timelock-admin. View-only — never mutates state.
 *
 * Scope note (spec §7.11):
 *   MetaAGQuoter quotes ONLY vault-side (oracle-priced) swaps.
 *   Cross-adapter aggregation lives on MetaAGRouter.getBestQuote() / getAllQuotes().
 */
interface IMetaAGQuoter {

    struct QuoteResult {
        uint256 amountIn;
        uint256 amountOut;
        uint256 grossAmountOut;
        uint256 executionPrice;
        uint256 spotPriceIn;
        uint256 spotPriceOut;
        uint256 feeAmount;
        uint256 feeBps;
        bool sufficientLiquidity;
        uint256 availableLiquidity;
        uint256 priceTimestampIn;
        uint256 priceTimestampOut;
        bool priceStaleIn;
        bool priceStaleOut;
    }

    struct QuoteRequest {
        address tokenIn;
        address tokenOut;
        uint256 amount;
        bool isExactIn;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.11)
     * @param priceOracle IPriceOracle address
     * @param vault IPECORVault address
     * @param weth Wrapped native coin (WPAX on Paxeer)
     * @param pecor PECOR engine address (for fee staticcall lookup)
     * @param admin Timelock — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(
        address priceOracle,
        address vault,
        address weth,
        address pecor,
        address admin
    ) external;

    function quoteExactIn(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn
    ) external view returns (QuoteResult memory result);

    function quoteExactOut(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountOut
    ) external view returns (QuoteResult memory result);

    function quoteExactInNative(
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 nativeAmountIn
    ) external view returns (QuoteResult memory result);

    function quoteExactInToNative(
        address tokenIn,
        uint256 amountIn
    ) external view returns (QuoteResult memory result);

    function quoteMarketBuy(
        address stablecoin,
        address token,
        uint256 stablecoinAmount
    ) external view returns (QuoteResult memory result);

    function quoteMarketSell(
        address token,
        address stablecoin,
        uint256 tokenAmount
    ) external view returns (QuoteResult memory result);

    function batchQuote(
        QuoteRequest[] calldata requests
    ) external view returns (QuoteResult[] memory results);

    function getLiquidityInfo(
        address token
    ) external view returns (uint256 available, uint256 tokenPrice, bool isStale);

    function getAllLiquidityInfo()
        external
        view
        returns (
            address[] memory tokens,
            uint256[] memory reserves,
            uint256[] memory prices,
            bool[] memory stale
        );

    function getTokenPrice(
        address token
    ) external view returns (uint256 price, uint256 timestamp, bool isStale);

    function getTokenPrices(
        address[] calldata tokens
    )
        external
        view
        returns (uint256[] memory prices, uint256[] memory timestamps, bool[] memory stale);

    function getTWAP(address token, uint256 period) external view returns (uint256);
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

import {IProtocolAdapter} from "./IProtocolAdapter.sol";

/**
 * @title IMetaAGRouter
 * @notice Canonical user-facing multi-protocol meta-router. Spec §7.10.
 * @dev UUPS-upgradeable, Timelock-admin, ReentrancyGuard, Pausable, Multicall.
 *      Polls registered IProtocolAdapter instances for best amountOut, executes,
 *      oracle-sanity-checks, and supports multi-hop across heterogeneous adapters.
 *
 * Oracle sanity invariant (spec §7.10 / S4):
 *   When oracleSanityEnabled, the router fetches oracle prices for tokenIn / tokenOut.
 *   If either price is UNAVAILABLE the check is SKIPPED (not failed) — the adapter's
 *   own slippage guard is the sole protection. If both are available and actual
 *   amountOut deviates from expectedOut by more than maxOracleSanityDeviation, the
 *   tx reverts.
 *
 * Multi-hop re-quote invariant (spec §7.10 / S3):
 *   swapMultiHop re-queries getQuote between hops with the actual intermediate
 *   amount to recompute adapter price impact per leg.
 *
 * Approval-reset invariant (spec §7.10 / S9):
 *   After every swap, the router resets its tokenIn allowance on the winning
 *   adapter to zero.
 */
interface IMetaAGRouter {

    struct AdapterEntry {
        bytes32 adapterId;
        address adapter;
        bool active;
        string name;
    }

    struct BestQuote {
        uint256 amountOut;
        uint256 priceImpactBps;
        uint256 feeBps;
        uint256 feeAmount;
        bytes32 adapterId;
        address adapter;
        bytes adapterData;
        bool found;
    }

    struct HopParams {
        address tokenIn;
        address tokenOut;
        bytes32 adapterId;
        uint256 minAmountOut;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.10)
     * @param oracleHub IOracleHub address used for output sanity checks
     * @param maxSanityDeviation Max deviation (BPS) before sanity revert (spec Q5 = 500)
     * @param admin Timelock — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(address oracleHub, uint256 maxSanityDeviation, address admin) external;

    /**
     * @notice Register a new adapter (reads adapter.adapterId() for collision check).
     *         Caller must have DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (Timelock).
     */
    function registerAdapter(address adapter) external;

    /// @notice Remove an inactive adapter, reclaiming its ID and registry capacity.
    function removeAdapter(bytes32 adapterId) external;

    function deactivateAdapter(bytes32 adapterId) external;

    function activateAdapter(bytes32 adapterId) external;

    function setOracleHub(address hub) external;

    function setOracleSanityDeviation(uint256 bps) external;

    function setOracleSanityEnabled(bool enabled) external;

    function pause() external;

    function unpause() external;

    /**
     * @notice Best quote across all active adapters (no side effects).
     */
    function getBestQuote(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn
    ) external view returns (BestQuote memory best);

    /**
     * @notice Every adapter's quote for a pair. Parallel arrays.
     * @return quotes Array of IProtocolAdapter.QuoteResult
     * @return adapterIds Array of adapter IDs
     * @return names Array of adapter names
     */
    function getAllQuotes(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn
    )
        external
        view
        returns (
            IProtocolAdapter.QuoteResult[] memory quotes,
            bytes32[] memory adapterIds,
            string[] memory names
        );

    /**
     * @notice Swap using the best available adapter (highest amountOut).
     */
    function swapBestRoute(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external returns (uint256 amountOut);

    /**
     * @notice Swap via a specific adapter (user-specified, bypasses best-route selection).
     */
    function swapViaAdapter(
        bytes32 adapterId,
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external returns (uint256 amountOut);

    /**
     * @notice Execute a multi-hop swap across multiple adapters. Re-queries each hop.
     */
    function swapMultiHop(
        HopParams[] calldata hops,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external returns (uint256 amountOut);

    function getAdapters() external view returns (AdapterEntry[] memory);

    function getAdapter(bytes32 adapterId) external view returns (AdapterEntry memory);

    function adapterCount() external view returns (uint256);

    function isAdapterActive(bytes32 adapterId) external view returns (bool);

    function oracleHub() external view returns (address);

    function maxOracleSanityDeviation() external view returns (uint256);

    function oracleSanityEnabled() external view returns (bool);

    event AdapterRegistered(bytes32 indexed adapterId, address indexed adapter, string name);
    event AdapterDeactivated(bytes32 indexed adapterId);
    event AdapterActivated(bytes32 indexed adapterId);
    event OracleHubUpdated(address indexed hub);
    event OracleSanityDeviationUpdated(uint256 bps);
    event OracleSanityEnabledUpdated(bool enabled);
    event BestRouteSwap(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenIn,
        address indexed tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        bytes32 adapterId
    );
    event MultiHopSwap(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenIn,
        address indexed tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 hops
    );
    event OracleSanityCheckFailed(
        address indexed tokenOut,
        uint256 expectedPrice,
        uint256 actualAmountOut,
        uint256 deviationBps
    );
}

contracts/meta-ag/interfaces/IOracleHub..content:
// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

import {IDataFeedAdapter} from "./IDataFeedAdapter.sol";

/**
 * @title IOracleHub
 * @notice Consumer-facing interface for the OracleHub meta-oracle aggregator
 * @dev OracleHub aggregates N IDataFeedAdapter sources with priority ordering,
 *      deviation circuit-breakers, and graceful fallback (spec §7.2).
 *
 * Integration pattern for new apps:
 *   1. Deploy your adapter implementing IDataFeedAdapter
 *   2. Call hub.registerAdapter(adapterAddress, priority)
 *   3. Consume prices via hub.getPrice(token) or hub.getAggregatedPrice(token)
 */
interface IOracleHub {

    struct AggregatedPrice {
        uint256 price;
        uint256 timestamp;
        uint256 confidence;
        uint256 sourceCount;
        bytes32 primarySource;
    }

    struct AdapterInfo {
        address adapter;
        uint256 priority;
        bool active;
        bytes32 sourceId;
        string name;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.2)
     * @param primaryOracle IPriceOracle used as strict TWAP
     * @param deviationBps Initial deviation circuit-breaker threshold (BPS)
     * @param minConfidence Minimum confidence score required to serve a price (0–10000)
     * @param admin Timelock — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(
        address primaryOracle,
        uint256 deviationBps,
        uint256 minConfidence,
        address admin
    ) external;

    /**
     * @notice Get the best available price for a token
     * @dev Uses highest-priority adapter that returns non-stale, non-zero price.
     *      Reverts if no valid price is found from any adapter.
     * @param token The token address
     * @return price Token price in USD, 18 decimals
     */
    function getPrice(address token) external view returns (uint256 price);

    /**
     * @notice Get the aggregated price with full metadata
     * @dev Aggregates across all active adapters. Uses confidence-weighted median.
     *      Does NOT revert on partial failures — reports sourceCount=0 if all fail.
     * @param token The token address
     * @return result The AggregatedPrice struct
     */
    function getAggregatedPrice(
        address token
    ) external view returns (AggregatedPrice memory result);

    /**
     * @notice Get a price from a specific adapter by sourceId
     * @param token The token address
     * @param sourceId The adapter sourceId to query
     * @return feed The FeedPrice from that specific adapter
     */
    function getPriceFromSource(
        address token,
        bytes32 sourceId
    ) external view returns (IDataFeedAdapter.FeedPrice memory feed);

    /**
     * @notice Get prices for multiple tokens using best-available source
     * @param tokens Array of token addresses
     * @return prices Array of prices (18 decimals); 0 if unavailable
     * @return confidences Array of confidence scores (0–10000)
     */
    function getPricesBatch(
        address[] calldata tokens
    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory prices, uint256[] memory confidences);

    /**
     * @notice Get the TWAP price from the primary oracle adapter (if supported)
     * @dev Strict historical API: invalid, stale and uncovered windows revert
     * @param token The token address
     * @param period TWAP period in seconds
     * @return twapPrice The TWAP price, 18 decimals
     */
    function getTWAP(address token, uint256 period) external view returns (uint256 twapPrice);

    /**
     * @notice Check if a valid (non-stale, non-zero) price exists for a token
     * @param token The token address
     * @return available True if at least one adapter has a valid price
     * @return bestConfidence The highest confidence score available
     */
    function isPriceAvailable(
        address token
    ) external view returns (bool available, uint256 bestConfidence);

    /**
     * @notice Register a new data feed adapter
     * @param adapter The IDataFeedAdapter-compliant contract address
     * @param priority Priority order (0 = highest priority, used first)
     */
    function registerAdapter(address adapter, uint256 priority) external;

    /**
     * @notice Deactivate an adapter (does not remove, just disables)
     * @param sourceId The adapter's sourceId to deactivate
     */
    /// @notice Remove a retired adapter, releasing its source ID, address and capacity.
    function removeAdapter(bytes32 sourceId) external;

    function deactivateAdapter(bytes32 sourceId) external;

    /**
     * @notice Reactivate a previously deactivated adapter
     * @param sourceId The adapter's sourceId to reactivate
     */
    function activateAdapter(bytes32 sourceId) external;

    /**
     * @notice Update the priority of an existing adapter
     * @param sourceId The adapter's sourceId
     * @param newPriority New priority value (lower = higher priority)
     */
    function setAdapterPriority(bytes32 sourceId, uint256 newPriority) external;

    /**
     * @notice Set the max deviation allowed between adapters before circuit breaking
     * @param deviationBps Max deviation in BPS (e.g., 500 = 5%)
     */
    function setDeviationThreshold(uint256 deviationBps) external;

    /**
     * @notice Set the minimum confidence score required to use a price
     * @param minConfidence Minimum confidence 0–10000
     */
    function setMinConfidence(uint256 minConfidence) external;

    /**
     * @notice Set the primary oracle used for strict TWAP (spec §7.2)
     * @param oracle Address of the IPriceOracle-compatible contract
     */
    function setPrimaryOracle(address oracle) external;

    /**
     * @notice Get all registered adapters
     * @return adapters Array of AdapterInfo structs
     */
    function getAdapters() external view returns (AdapterInfo[] memory adapters);

    /**
     * @notice Get adapter info by sourceId
     * @param sourceId The adapter's sourceId
     * @return info The AdapterInfo struct
     */
    function getAdapter(bytes32 sourceId) external view returns (AdapterInfo memory info);

    /**
     * @notice Get the number of registered adapters
     * @return count Total adapter count (active + inactive)
     */
    function adapterCount() external view returns (uint256 count);

    /**
     * @notice The current deviation threshold in BPS
     */
    function deviationThresholdBps() external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @notice The minimum confidence score threshold
     */
    function minConfidence() external view returns (uint256);

    /// @notice Emergency pause; blocks price queries (spec §7.2).
    function pause() external;

    /// @notice Resume price queries after pause.
    function unpause() external;

    event AdapterRegistered(bytes32 indexed sourceId, address indexed adapter, uint256 priority);
    event AdapterDeactivated(bytes32 indexed sourceId);
    event AdapterActivated(bytes32 indexed sourceId);
    event AdapterPriorityUpdated(bytes32 indexed sourceId, uint256 newPriority);
    event DeviationThresholdUpdated(uint256 newThresholdBps);
    event MinConfidenceUpdated(uint256 newMinConfidence);
    event PrimaryOracleUpdated(address indexed oracle);
    event CircuitBreakerTriggered(
        address indexed token,
        bytes32 indexed sourceId,
        uint256 reportedPrice,
        uint256 referencePrice,
        uint256 deviationBps
    );
    event PriceServed(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 confidence,
        uint256 sourceCount
    );
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IPECOR
 * @notice Interface for the PECOR engine — oracle-priced swap execution with tiered fees
 *         and price-impact against PECORVault v2. Spec §7.6.
 * @dev UUPS-upgradeable, Timelock-admin. Orders (limit, stop-loss, stop-limit) are
 *      specified on IPECOROrders — NOT here.
 *
 * Fee-tier invariant (spec §7.6):
 *   effectiveFeeBps(volumeUSD) = swapFeeBps
 *     + (volumeUSD >= TIER1 ? tier1FeeBps : 0)
 *     + (volumeUSD >= TIER2 ? tier2FeeBps : 0)
 *   Stacking sum capped at MAX_FEE_BPS (200).
 */
interface IPECOR {

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.6)
     * @param priceOracle IPriceOracle address (source of truth for vault-side prices)
     * @param vault IPECORVault v2 address
     * @param weth Wrapped native coin (WPAX on Paxeer)
     * @param tracker ITransactionTracker address (may be zero at bootstrap)
     * @param admin Timelock — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(
        address priceOracle,
        address vault,
        address weth,
        address tracker,
        address admin
    ) external;

    function setPriceOracle(address oracle) external;

    function setTransactionTracker(address tracker) external;

    function setSwapFee(uint256 feeBps) external;

    function setTieredFees(uint256 tier1FeeBps, uint256 tier2FeeBps) external;

    function setPriceImpact(bool enabled, uint256 scalarBps) external;

    function setFeeCollector(address collector) external;

    function pause() external;

    function unpause() external;

    function collectFees(address token) external;

    function swapExactIn(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external returns (uint256 amountOut);

    function swapExactOut(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 amountInMax,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external returns (uint256 amountIn);

    function marketBuy(
        address stablecoin,
        address token,
        uint256 stablecoinAmount,
        uint256 minTokenAmount,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external returns (uint256 tokenAmount);

    function marketSell(
        address token,
        address stablecoin,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        uint256 minStablecoinAmount,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external returns (uint256 stablecoinAmount);

    function swapExactInNative(
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external payable returns (uint256 amountOut);

    function swapExactInToNative(
        address tokenIn,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external returns (uint256 amountOut);

    function getQuoteExactIn(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn
    ) external view returns (uint256 amountOut);

    function getQuoteExactOut(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountOut
    ) external view returns (uint256 amountIn);

    /**
     * @notice Full oracle-priced quote with price impact and fee breakdown.
     * @return grossOut Raw amountOut before fee / impact.
     * @return netOut amountOut user actually receives.
     * @return priceImpactBps Price impact applied (BPS).
     * @return feeBps Effective fee rate after tiered stacking (BPS).
     * @return feeAmount Fee deducted from grossOut.
     */
    function getDetailedQuote(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn
    )
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 grossOut,
            uint256 netOut,
            uint256 priceImpactBps,
            uint256 feeBps,
            uint256 feeAmount
        );

    /// @notice Batch multiple calls atomically via delegatecall (spec §7.6).
    function multicall(bytes[] calldata data) external returns (bytes[] memory results);

    event SimpleSwap(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenIn,
        address indexed tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 executionPrice
    );
    event MarketOrderExecuted(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed stablecoin,
        address indexed token,
        uint256 stablecoinAmount,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        bool isBuy
    );
    event NativeSwap(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenOther,
        uint256 nativeAmount,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        bool nativeIsInput
    );
    event PriceImpactApplied(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenOut,
        uint256 impactBps,
        uint256 deductedAmount
    );
    event TieredFeeApplied(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenOut,
        uint256 volumeUSD,
        uint256 feeBps,
        uint256 feeAmount
    );
    event SwapFeeUpdated(uint256 feeBps);
    event TieredFeesUpdated(uint256 tier1FeeBps, uint256 tier2FeeBps);
    event PriceImpactConfigUpdated(bool enabled, uint256 scalarBps);
    event FeeCollectorUpdated(address indexed collector);
    event PriceOracleUpdated(address indexed oracle);
    event TransactionTrackerUpdated(address indexed tracker);
    event FeesCollected(address indexed token, address indexed collector, uint256 amount);
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IPECORVault
 * @notice Interface for PECORVault v2 — single multi-asset vault holding all non-Sidiora
 *         liquidity. Operator-gated pull/push. UUPS-upgradeable, Timelock-admin.
 * @dev Spec §7.5. Replaces live vault at
 *      0x6500B1B3F8067772041C68b2c51D8E7A84e20C31 via Migration Path M1.
 *
 * USDL registration invariant (spec §7.5):
 *   USDL MUST be registered via registerToken(USDL, true) before the first
 *   vault-adjacent swap. Without this, the vault cannot bridge between
 *   Sidiora and vault liquidity.
 */
interface IPECORVault {

    struct TokenInfo {
        bool isRegistered;
        bool isStablecoin;
        uint8 decimals;
        uint256 reserves;
        uint256 totalDeposited;
        uint256 totalWithdrawn;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.5)
     * @param weth Wrapped native coin address (WPAX on Paxeer)
     * @param tracker ITransactionTracker address (may be zero at bootstrap)
     * @param admin Timelock address — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(address weth, address tracker, address admin) external;

    function registerToken(address token, bool isStablecoin) external;

    function setStablecoinStatus(address token, bool isStablecoin) external;

    function setOperator(address operator, bool authorized) external;

    function setTransactionTracker(address tracker) external;

    function emergencyWithdraw(address token, uint256 amount, address recipient) external;

    function syncReserves(address token) external;

    function syncAllReserves() external;

    /// @notice Inventory donation; creates no depositor shares or withdrawal entitlement.
    function deposit(address token, uint256 amount) external;

    function depositBatch(address[] calldata tokenList, uint256[] calldata amounts) external;

    /// @notice Wrap native coin into WETH and credit reserves (WETH must be registered).
    function depositNative() external payable;

    /**
     * @notice Pull tokens from `from` into the vault (fee-on-transfer safe).
     * @return actualAmount Amount actually received after any token-side fees.
     */
    function pullTokens(
        address token,
        address from,
        uint256 amount
    ) external returns (uint256 actualAmount);

    function pushTokens(address token, address to, uint256 amount) external;

    /// @notice Unwrap WETH to native coin and forward to recipient.
    function withdrawNative(uint256 amount, address to) external;

    function updateReserves(
        address tokenIn,
        uint256 amountIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountOut
    ) external;

    /// @notice Reserve refundable escrow/fees against free inventory, owned by the caller.
    function reserveTokens(address token, uint256 amount) external;
    function releaseTokens(address token, uint256 amount) external;
    function getAvailableReserves(address token) external view returns (uint256);
    function getReservedBalance(address token) external view returns (uint256);

    function getReserves(address token) external view returns (uint256);

    /// @dev Flat-tuple return preserves live ABI compatibility. Use getTokenInfo; no tokens() auto-getter exists.
    function getTokenInfo(
        address token
    )
        external
        view
        returns (
            bool isRegistered,
            bool isStablecoin,
            uint8 decimals,
            uint256 reserves,
            uint256 totalDeposited,
            uint256 totalWithdrawn
        );

    function isStablecoin(address token) external view returns (bool);

    function getTokenDecimals(address token) external view returns (uint8);

    function getRegisteredTokens() external view returns (address[] memory);

    function getRegisteredStablecoins() external view returns (address[] memory);

    function getRegisteredTokenCount() external view returns (uint256);

    function hasLiquidity(address token, uint256 amount) external view returns (bool);

    function getAllReserves() external view returns (address[] memory, uint256[] memory);

    function getUntrackedFunds(address token) external view returns (uint256);

    event TokenRegistered(address indexed token, uint8 decimals, bool isStablecoin);
    event StablecoinStatusUpdated(address indexed token, bool isStablecoin);
    event Deposit(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed depositor,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    );
    event Withdrawal(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed recipient,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    );
    event NativeDeposit(address indexed depositor, uint256 amount, uint256 newReserve);
    event NativeWithdrawal(address indexed recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 newReserve);
    event OperatorUpdated(address indexed operator, bool authorized);
    event TransactionTrackerUpdated(address indexed tracker);
    event ReservesUpdated(address indexed token, uint256 oldReserve, uint256 newReserve);
    event ReservesSync(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 oldReserves,
        uint256 newReserves,
        uint256 recovered
    );
    event EmergencyWithdraw(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed recipient,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    );
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IPriceOracle
 * @notice Interface for the Paxeer Price Oracle — multi-relayer, staleness-protected, TWAP-enabled
 * @dev All prices use 18 decimal precision (PRICE_DECIMALS = 18).
 *
 * Architecture (spec §7.1):
 *   - Off-chain relayers push prices via batchUpdatePrices()
 *   - On-chain staleness protection reverts getPrice() if data is too old
 *   - TWAP (Time-Weighted Average Price) computed on-chain from price history
 *   - Price bounds prevent erroneous updates (e.g., relayer bug pushing price to 0)
 */
interface IPriceOracle {

    struct PriceData {
        uint256 price;
        uint256 timestamp;
        uint256 roundId;
        address relayer;
    }

    struct TokenConfig {
        bool isRegistered;
        uint256 heartbeatInterval;
        uint256 deviationThresholdBps; // Off-chain minimum publication trigger; NOT an enforced jump limit.
        uint256 maxPriceBound;
        uint256 minPriceBound;
        uint256 maxStaleness;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.1)
     * @param admin Timelock — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(address admin) external;

    /**
     * @notice Get the latest price for a token
     * @dev REVERTS if price is stale (older than maxStaleness for that token)
     * @param token The token address to get the price for
     * @return price The token price in USD with 18 decimals
     */
    function getPrice(address token) external view returns (uint256 price);

    /**
     * @notice Get the latest price with full metadata
     * @dev REVERTS if price is stale
     * @param token The token address
     * @return price The token price (18 decimals)
     * @return timestamp When the price was last updated
     * @return roundId The round number of this price update
     */
    function getPriceWithTimestamp(
        address token
    ) external view returns (uint256 price, uint256 timestamp, uint256 roundId);

    /**
     * @notice Get the Time-Weighted Average Price over a period
     * @dev Exact requested interval, requiring fresh latest data and full retained coverage.
     * New bounded observations begin on first post-upgrade update; legacy rounds remain stored.
     * @param token The token address
     * @param period The TWAP period in seconds (e.g., 300 for 5-minute TWAP)
     * @return twapPrice The TWAP with 18 decimals
     */
    function getTWAP(address token, uint256 period) external view returns (uint256 twapPrice);

    /**
     * @notice Check if a token's price is stale
     * @param token The token address
     * @return stale True if the price is older than maxStaleness
     */
    function isPriceStale(address token) external view returns (bool stale);

    /**
     * @notice Get the price decimals constant
     * @return decimals Always returns 18
     */
    // solhint-disable-next-line func-name-mixedcase
    function PRICE_DECIMALS() external pure returns (uint8 decimals);

    /**
     * @notice Get prices for multiple tokens in a single call
     * @dev Does NOT revert on stale prices — returns staleness flags instead
     * @param tokens Array of token addresses
     * @return prices Array of prices (18 decimals), 0 if not registered
     * @return timestamps Array of last update timestamps
     * @return staleFlags Array of staleness booleans
     */
    function getPrices(
        address[] calldata tokens
    )
        external
        view
        returns (uint256[] memory prices, uint256[] memory timestamps, bool[] memory staleFlags);

    /**
     * @notice Get recent price history for a token
     * @param token The token address
     * @param count Number of recent rounds to retrieve (capped at 1000)
     * @return history Array of PriceData structs (most recent first)
     */
    function getPriceHistory(
        address token,
        uint256 count
    ) external view returns (PriceData[] memory history);

    /**
     * @notice Get the latest round data for a token
     * @param token The token address
     * @return data The latest PriceData struct
     */
    function getLatestRound(address token) external view returns (PriceData memory data);

    /**
     * @notice Get a retained round (new rounds older than the latest 1000 are unavailable)
     * @param token The token address
     * @param roundId The round number to query
     * @return data The PriceData for that round
     */
    function getRoundData(
        address token,
        uint256 roundId
    ) external view returns (PriceData memory data);

    /**
     * @notice Get the configuration for a token
     * @param token The token address
     * @return config The TokenConfig struct
     */
    function getTokenConfig(address token) external view returns (TokenConfig memory config);

    /**
     * @notice Get all registered token addresses
     * @return tokens Array of registered token addresses
     */
    function getRegisteredTokens() external view returns (address[] memory tokens);

    /**
     * @notice Check if a relayer is authorized
     * @param relayer The address to check
     * @return authorized True if the relayer is authorized to push prices
     */
    function isAuthorizedRelayer(address relayer) external view returns (bool authorized);

    /**
     * @notice Update the price of a single token
     * @dev Only callable by authorized relayers. Validates against price bounds.
     * @param token The token address
     * @param price The new price (18 decimals)
     */
    function updatePrice(address token, uint256 price) external;

    /**
     * @notice Update prices for multiple tokens in a single transaction
     * @dev Primary method for relayers. Gas is free on Paxeer, so push all tokens every heartbeat.
     * @param tokens Array of token addresses
     * @param prices Array of new prices (18 decimals)
     */
    function batchUpdatePrices(address[] calldata tokens, uint256[] calldata prices) external;

    /**
     * @notice Register a new token with its oracle configuration
     * @param token The token address to register
     * @param heartbeatInterval Max seconds between updates
     * @param deviationThresholdBps Min deviation to warrant update (BPS)
     * @param minPrice Lower price bound (18 decimals)
     * @param maxPrice Upper price bound (18 decimals)
     * @param maxStaleness Seconds after which price is stale
     */
    function registerToken(
        address token,
        uint256 heartbeatInterval,
        uint256 deviationThresholdBps,
        uint256 minPrice,
        uint256 maxPrice,
        uint256 maxStaleness
    ) external;

    /**
     * @notice Update the configuration of an existing token
     * @param token The token address
     * @param config The new TokenConfig
     */
    function updateTokenConfig(address token, TokenConfig calldata config) external;

    /**
     * @notice Set the authorization status of a relayer
     * @param relayer The relayer address
     * @param authorized True to authorize, false to revoke
     */
    function setRelayer(address relayer, bool authorized) external;

    /// @notice Emergency pause; blocks price pushes (spec §7.1).
    function pause() external;

    /// @notice Resume price pushes after pause.
    function unpause() external;

    event PriceUpdated(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 indexed roundId,
        address indexed relayer,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    event BatchPriceUpdate(address indexed relayer, uint256 tokenCount, uint256 timestamp);

    event TokenRegistered(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 heartbeatInterval,
        uint256 deviationThresholdBps,
        uint256 minPrice,
        uint256 maxPrice,
        uint256 maxStaleness
    );

    event TokenConfigUpdated(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 heartbeatInterval,
        uint256 deviationThresholdBps,
        uint256 minPrice,
        uint256 maxPrice,
        uint256 maxStaleness
    );

    event RelayerUpdated(address indexed relayer, bool authorized);

    event StalePriceDetected(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 lastUpdateTimestamp,
        uint256 currentTimestamp,
        uint256 maxStaleness
    );
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IProtocolAdapter
 * @notice Standardized interface for pluggable swap protocol adapters consumed by MetaAGRouter
 * @dev Implement this to plug any AMM/DEX/vault into the multi-protocol router.
 *
 * Examples:
 *   - VaultAdapter    → wraps PECORVault oracle-priced swaps
 *   - SidioraAdapter  → wraps Sidiora bonding-curve pools (buy/sell/token-to-token)
 *   - Future: UniV2Adapter, CurveAdapter, etc.
 *
 * Token pair support:
 *   - Adapters declare supported pairs via supportsSwap()
 *   - Router queries all adapters to find best quote before execution
 *
 * Invariants (spec §6.1):
 *   I1. getQuote never reverts — return available=false, amountOut=0 instead.
 *   I2. executeSwap enforces require(amountOut >= minAmountOut).
 *   I3. Adapter honors deadline (or treats 0 as no-deadline).
 *   I4. Adapter pulls tokenIn from `from`, sends tokenOut to `recipient`;
 *       no dust remains inside adapter.
 *   I5. adapterId = keccak256("Name.vN"); collisions revert at registration.
 *   I6. adapterData round-trips: Router re-queries getQuote and passes its
 *       adapterData directly to executeSwap.
 */
interface IProtocolAdapter {

    struct QuoteResult {
        uint256 amountOut;
        uint256 priceImpactBps;
        uint256 feeBps;
        // Adapter-specific denomination: Vault = tokenOut; Sidiora single-hop =
        // tokenIn; Sidiora token-to-token = USDL at sell execution rate.
        uint256 feeAmount;
        bool available;
        bytes adapterData;
    }

    struct SwapResult {
        uint256 amountOut;
        uint256 feeAmount;
        bytes adapterData;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Get a quote for swapping amountIn of tokenIn for tokenOut
     * @dev MUST NOT revert — return available=false if unsupported or no liquidity
     * @param tokenIn The input token address
     * @param tokenOut The output token address
     * @param amountIn The exact input amount
     * @return result The QuoteResult with amountOut, impact, fee, and execution data
     */
    function getQuote(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn
    ) external view returns (QuoteResult memory result);

    /**
     * @notice Execute a swap through this adapter
     * @dev Caller must have approved tokenIn to this adapter
     *      before calling. Adapter pulls tokenIn from `from`, sends tokenOut to `recipient`.
     * @param tokenIn The input token address
     * @param tokenOut The output token address
     * @param amountIn The exact input amount
     * @param minAmountOut Minimum acceptable output (slippage guard)
     * @param from Address to pull tokenIn from (must equal msg.sender and have approved)
     * @param recipient Address to send tokenOut to
     * @param deadline Unix timestamp after which the swap reverts
     * @param adapterData Encoded execution data from getQuote() (e.g., pool address)
     * @return result The SwapResult with actual amountOut and fee
     */
    function executeSwap(
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 minAmountOut,
        address from,
        address recipient,
        uint256 deadline,
        bytes calldata adapterData
    ) external returns (SwapResult memory result);

    /**
     * @notice Check if this adapter supports a specific token pair
     * @param tokenIn The input token address
     * @param tokenOut The output token address
     * @return supported True if the pair can be routed through this adapter
     */
    function supportsSwap(address tokenIn, address tokenOut) external view returns (bool supported);

    /**
     * @notice Get all token pairs this adapter currently supports
     * @dev May return an empty array if pairs are dynamically discovered
     * @return tokenIns Array of input token addresses
     * @return tokenOuts Array of corresponding output token addresses
     */
    function getSupportedPairs()
        external
        view
        returns (address[] memory tokenIns, address[] memory tokenOuts);

    /**
     * @notice Get the maximum input amount this adapter can handle for a pair
     * @dev Returns type(uint256).max if no practical limit
     * @param tokenIn The input token
     * @param tokenOut The output token
     * @return maxIn Maximum amountIn (limited by liquidity)
     */
    function getMaxInput(address tokenIn, address tokenOut) external view returns (uint256 maxIn);

    /**
     * @notice Unique identifier for this adapter (e.g., keccak256("Sidiora.v1"))
     * @return id The bytes32 identifier
     */
    function adapterId() external view returns (bytes32 id);

    /**
     * @notice Human-readable name for this adapter
     * @return name The adapter name
     */
    function adapterName() external view returns (string memory name);

    /**
     * @notice Protocol version string
     * @return version e.g. "1.0.0"
     */
    function adapterVersion() external view returns (string memory version);

    event SwapExecuted(
        bytes32 indexed adapterId,
        address indexed tokenIn,
        address indexed tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        address recipient
    );
}

    struct DailyStats {
        uint256 totalVolume;
        uint256 totalTrades;
        uint256 uniqueTraders;
        uint256 timestamp;
    }

    struct TokenStats {
        uint256 totalVolume;
        uint256 tradeCount;
        uint256 lastTradeTimestamp;
    }

    struct UserStats {
        uint256 totalVolume;
        uint256 tradeCount;
        uint256 firstTradeTimestamp;
        uint256 lastTradeTimestamp;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Initialize the UUPS proxy (spec §7.12)
     * @param admin Timelock — granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
     */
    function initialize(address admin) external;

    /// @notice Grant / revoke EMITTER_ROLE to a contract address (spec §7.12).
    function setAuthorizedEmitter(address emitter, bool authorized) external;

    /// @notice Force a daily stats snapshot (e.g., ops-driven day rollover).
    function forceDaySnapshot() external;

    function recordTrade(
        address user,
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 volumeUSD
    ) external;

    function recordMarketTrade(
        address user,
        address stablecoin,
        address token,
        uint256 stablecoinAmount,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 executionPrice
    ) external;

    function recordLimitOrderPlaced(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        address token,
        address stablecoin,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 targetPrice,
        bool isBuy
    ) external;

    function recordLimitOrderExecuted(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        uint256 executionPrice
    ) external;

    function recordLimitOrderCancelled(uint256 orderId, address user) external;

    function recordStopLossPlaced(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        address token,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        uint256 triggerPrice
    ) external;

    function recordStopLossTriggered(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        uint256 triggerPrice,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 amountOut
    ) external;

    function recordStopLimitPlaced(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        address token,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 stopPrice,
        uint256 limitPrice,
        bool isBuy
    ) external;

    function recordStopLimitActivated(uint256 orderId, uint256 activationPrice) external;

    function recordStopLimitExecuted(
        uint256 orderId,
        address user,
        uint256 executionPrice
    ) external;

    function recordLiquidityAdded(
        address token,
        address provider,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    ) external;

    function recordLiquidityRemoved(
        address token,
        address remover,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve
    ) external;

    function getDailyStats(uint256 dayTimestamp) external view returns (DailyStats memory);

    function getTokenStats(address token) external view returns (TokenStats memory);

    function getUserStats(address user) external view returns (UserStats memory);

    function getCurrentDayStats() external view returns (DailyStats memory);

    event TradeExecuted(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenIn,
        address indexed tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 volumeUSD,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event MarketTrade(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed stablecoin,
        address indexed token,
        uint256 stablecoinAmount,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LimitOrderPlaced(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        address indexed token,
        address stablecoin,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 targetPrice,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LimitOrderExecuted(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LimitOrderCancelled(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLossPlaced(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        address indexed token,
        uint256 tokenAmount,
        uint256 triggerPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLossTriggered(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 triggerPrice,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLimitPlaced(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        address indexed token,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 stopPrice,
        uint256 limitPrice,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLimitActivated(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        uint256 activationPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event StopLimitExecuted(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 executionPrice,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LiquidityAdded(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed provider,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event LiquidityRemoved(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed remover,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 newReserve,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event DailyStatsSnapshot(
        uint256 indexed dayTimestamp,
        uint256 totalVolume,
        uint256 totalTrades,
        uint256 uniqueTraders
    );
    event TokenVolumeUpdate(
        address indexed token,
        uint256 dailyVolume,
        uint256 totalVolume,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event VaultLiquidityUpdate(address indexed token, uint256 reserve, uint256 timestamp);
    event UserTradeMetrics(
        address indexed user,
        uint256 totalVolume,
        uint256 tradeCount,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event AuthorizedEmitterUpdated(address indexed emitter, bool authorized);
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

/**
 * @title IWETH
 * @notice Interface for Wrapped Native Coin (WETH / WPAX)
 * @dev Standard WETH9 surface used by Uniswap, Aave, and every major DeFi protocol.
 *      On Paxeer Network, the canonical WETH is WPAX at
 *      0xe5ccf339d1c89c7e6c6768b28507f78b861fc1de (see LIVE_ADDRESSES in tests).
 */
interface IWETH {
    function deposit() external payable;

    function withdraw(uint256 wad) external;

    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);

    function balanceOf(address owner) external view returns (uint256);

    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);

    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external returns (bool);

    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);

    event Deposit(address indexed dst, uint256 wad);
    event Withdrawal(address indexed src, uint256 wad);
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

import {IDataFeedAdapter} from "../../interfaces/IDataFeedAdapter.sol";
import {IPriceOracle} from "../../interfaces/IPriceOracle.sol";

/// @title PriceOracleAdapter
/// @notice {IDataFeedAdapter} wrapper around an {IPriceOracle} instance.
/// @dev Immutable by design (spec §7.3): no admin, no upgrade path, no mutable state beyond
///      the single `priceOracle` pointer set at construction. Translates per-token staleness
///      and `TokenConfig.heartbeatInterval` into the canonical 4-band confidence signal
///      (FRESH / AGING / NEAR_STALE / 0) mandated by I8.
///
/// Confidence mapping (aligned with dev/adapters/PriceOracleAdapter.sol):
///   - age <= heartbeat                           -> 9000 (FRESH)
///   - heartbeat  <  age <= 2 * heartbeat         -> 6000 (AGING)
///   - 2 * heartbeat < age <= maxStaleness        -> 3000 (NEAR_STALE)
///   - age > maxStaleness                         -> 0
///
/// Never reverts on missing / stale data (I7) — returns zero-price, zero-confidence FeedPrice.
contract PriceOracleAdapter is IDataFeedAdapter {

    bytes32 private constant _SOURCE_ID = keccak256("PaxeerPriceOracle.v1");
    uint256 private constant _STALENESS_SECONDS = 3600;

    uint256 public constant CONFIDENCE_FRESH = 9000;
    uint256 public constant CONFIDENCE_AGING = 6000;
    uint256 public constant CONFIDENCE_NEAR_STALE = 3000;

    error ZeroAddress();

    IPriceOracle public immutable priceOracle;

    constructor(address priceOracle_) {
        if (priceOracle_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
        priceOracle = IPriceOracle(priceOracle_);
    }

    function sourceId() external pure override returns (bytes32) {
        return _SOURCE_ID;
    }

    function adapterName() external pure override returns (string memory) {
        return "PaxeerPriceOracle.v1";
    }

    function maxStaleness() external pure override returns (uint256) {
        // Token-specific expiry is enforced in _readFeed; no hidden global cap.
        return type(uint256).max;
    }

    function supportsToken(address token) external view override returns (bool) {
        return priceOracle.getTokenConfig(token).isRegistered;
    }

    function getSupportedTokens() external view override returns (address[] memory tokens) {
        return priceOracle.getRegisteredTokens();
    }

    function getFeedPrice(address token) external view override returns (FeedPrice memory feed) {
        return _readFeed(token);
    }

    function getFeedPrices(
        address[] calldata tokens
    ) external view override returns (FeedPrice[] memory feeds) {
        feeds = new FeedPrice[](tokens.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; ++i) {
            feeds[i] = _readFeed(tokens[i]);
        }
    }

    function _readFeed(address token) internal view returns (FeedPrice memory feed) {
        feed.sourceId = _SOURCE_ID;

        IPriceOracle.TokenConfig memory config = priceOracle.getTokenConfig(token);
        if (!config.isRegistered) return feed;

        IPriceOracle.PriceData memory data = priceOracle.getLatestRound(token);
        if (data.timestamp == 0 || data.timestamp > block.timestamp) return feed;

        uint256 age = block.timestamp - data.timestamp;
        uint256 confidence;
        if (age > config.maxStaleness) {
            confidence = 0;
        } else if (age <= config.heartbeatInterval) {
            confidence = CONFIDENCE_FRESH;
        } else if (age - config.heartbeatInterval <= config.heartbeatInterval) {
            confidence = CONFIDENCE_AGING;
        } else {
            confidence = CONFIDENCE_NEAR_STALE;
        }

        feed.price = data.price;
        feed.timestamp = data.timestamp;
        feed.confidence = confidence;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-Paxlabs-HyperPax-OS-Protocol
pragma solidity ^0.8.27;

import {Proxy} from "../../base/Proxy.sol";
import {ERC1967Utils} from "../../base/ERC1967Utils.sol";

/// @title ERC1967Proxy
/// @notice Production ERC-1967 proxy used to wrap every Sidiora Meta-AG UUPS implementation
/// @dev Stores the implementation address in the ERC-1967 implementation slot and
///      delegates every call through the in-house {Proxy} base. On construction,
///      the proxy runs `initialize(...)` via delegatecall so that the proxy storage
///      is live from its first transaction.
///
/// Plan ref: docs/plans/pecor-sidiora-merge-plan.md Phase 10.2 ("deploy impl, deploy
/// `ERC1967Proxy`, call `initialize(...)`") — the same factory is reused by every
/// Phase 2–7 test fixture so that unit tests exercise real proxy wiring rather than
/// raw implementations.
///
/// Zero external dependencies — composes only `contracts/base/` primitives that are
/// already shipped for the live Launchpad.
contract ERC1967Proxy is Proxy {
    error InitializationFailed();

    /// @param implementation UUPS implementation contract
    /// @param data ABI-encoded call to `initialize(...)`. Pass `""` to skip.
    /// @dev On initializer failure we bubble up the implementation's revert
    ///      data verbatim (standard ERC-1967 pattern) so callers observe the
    ///      real custom error (e.g. {ZeroAddress}) instead of a generic
    ///      {InitializationFailed}. The latter is retained only as the
    ///      explicit fallback when the initializer reverted without any
    ///      return data.
    constructor(address implementation, bytes memory data) payable {
        ERC1967Utils.setImplementation(implementation);
        if (data.length > 0) {
            // solhint-disable-next-line avoid-low-level-calls
            (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = implementation.delegatecall(data);
            if (!ok) {
                if (ret.length == 0) revert InitializationFailed();
                assembly {
                    revert(add(ret, 32), mload(ret))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function _implementation() internal view override returns (address) {
        return ERC1967Utils.getImplementation();
    }
}

@title IMetaAGRouter

 @dev UUPS-upgradeable, Timelock-admin, ReentrancyGuard, Pausable, Multicall.

      oracle-sanity-checks, and supports multi-hop across heterogeneous adapters.
 Oracle sanity invariant (spec §7.10 / S4):
   When oracleSanityEnabled, the router fetches oracle prices for tokenIn / tokenOut.
   If either price is UNAVAILABLE the check is SKIPPED (not failed) — the adapter's
   own slippage guard is the sole protection. If both are available and actual
   amountOut deviates from expectedOut by more than maxOracleSanityDeviation, the
   tx reverts.
 Multi-hop re-quote invariant (spec §7.10 / S3):
   swapMultiHop re-queries getQuote between hops with the actual intermediate
   amount to recompute adapter price impact per leg.
 Approval-reset invariant (spec §7.10 / S9):
   After every swap, the router resets its tokenIn allowance on the winning
   adapter to zero.

@title LaunchpadOptical
 @notice Preset optical for serious projects: cliff + linear vesting for team wallets,
         plus a time-limited capital raise fee that diverts a portion of swap fees to the team as USDL.
 @dev Immutable once deployed. One instance per pool (constructor params are pool-specific).
      HOOKS USED:
        - beforeTokenTransfer:    Enforce cliff lock + linear vesting on all team transfers
        - beforeSwap/afterSwap:   Authenticated lifecycle hooks; no duplicate transfer accounting
        - beforeFeeDistribution:  Divert capitalRaiseBps of pool fees to optical surplus for team
      CAPITAL RAISE FLOW:
        1. beforeFeeDistribution reduces the pool fee by capitalRaiseBps%
        2. FeeAccumulator records the difference as opticalSurplus
        3. Team calls claimCapital() → LaunchpadOptical calls FeeAccumulator.claimOpticalSurplus()
        4. USDL is transferred to teamClaimAddress
